units.name: Pip Thistlewick
units.body: round-bellied and wiry, long nimble fingers, oversized ears
units.personality: Nervous, inventive, talks to his gadgets, overly proud of tiny victories.
units.quote: It only exploded a little!
units.origin: Quarry-town mender who built traps to keep wolves off the pumpkin patch.
units.weaponDesc: A stubby wooden crossbow with a hand-crank winch, coiled snare-wire spool, and a cracked brass pressure gauge; clearly homemade.
units.passive: Tinkerer's Luck: first trap each battle costs no AP. Visual: tiny gears spin out of the belt.
units.ability1: Snap Snare: roots one enemy in place for a turn. Visual: wire loops burst from the ground.
units.ability2: Pebble Volley: three weak Earth shots across the enemy line. Visual: gravel pellets from the crossbow.
units.ability3: Jury-Rig: repairs ally shield value, small. Visual: wrench swings, sparks and tape.
units.ultimate: Great Big Trap Bonanza: a field of snares and spring boards locks the whole enemy line. Visual: a comical contraption erupts from the earth with cogs and springs.

units.name: Bram Oakhelm
units.body: barrel-chested, thick-armed farmhand, broad and slightly soft, big hands
units.personality: Quiet, dependable, gently humorous, dislikes violence, loves his mule.
units.quote: Stand behind me. I've got a door.
units.origin: Farmhand who defended a well from raiders with the nearest thing he owned.
units.weaponDesc: A battered oak barn door cut into a tower shield, iron hinges still attached, painted blue rain-drops by a child.
units.passive: Stubborn as a Mule: takes 10% less damage while below half HP. Visual: a faint blue ripple around the shield.
units.ability1: Brace: gain shield and taunt for a turn. Visual: plants the door, ripple of water.
units.ability2: Bucket Brigade: splash heals ally slightly. Visual: tosses a pail of water over a friend.
units.ability3: Shoulder Shove: pushes enemy back and lowers its next attack. Visual: door slams forward.
units.ultimate: Flood Gate: a wall of water forms behind the shield, absorbing damage for the whole party. Visual: the barn door swings open, torrent surges.

units.name: Tilly Nettlebright
units.body: lean long-legged sprinter, small chest, narrow hips, scuffed knees
units.personality: Cheeky, restless, loyal, hates being told to wait.
units.quote: Catch me if you can. Spoiler: you can't.
units.origin: Runner who delivered messages between farms and dared the forest edge for shortcuts.
units.weaponDesc: A pair of oversized garden shears reforged into twin short blades with green cord-wrapped handles.
units.passive: Fleet Feet: acts first on turn one. Visual: green dust trail at her heels.
units.ability1: Dash Cut: strike and reposition behind the line. Visual: afterimage streak.
units.ability2: Gust Step: dodge next attack. Visual: a wind swirl lifts her scarf.
units.ability3: Hedge Slash: hits two enemies for modest damage. Visual: crossing green arcs.
units.ultimate: Hundred Fence Dash: a rapid-fire run through all enemies, hitting each once. Visual: a blur of green slashes and falling leaves.

units.name: Rook Emberwick
units.body: slender small reptilian frame, long tail, digitigrade legs, expressive frilled ears
units.personality: Timid, warm, nurturing, apologizes constantly, secretly brave when friends are hurt.
units.quote: S-sorry, but also, soup?
units.origin: Orphaned kobold who found safety tending the Silverbrook hearth.
units.weaponDesc: A long iron ladle with a hollow bowl that holds a tiny glowing coal, wrapped with colored yarn.
units.passive: Warm Hands: allies he heals also gain a little ongoing warmth regen. Visual: soft orange glow.
units.ability1: Stoke: gives an ally an energy boost. Visual: coals flare from the ladle.
units.ability2: Soup Splash: heals a small amount. Visual: a ladle swing of steaming broth.
units.ability3: Cinder Pop: weak Fire hit on an enemy. Visual: sparks from the ladle bowl.
units.ultimate: Hearth Feast: a big communal meal heals the whole party and boosts morale. Visual: a bubbling cauldron of golden light, steaming bowls appear.

units.name: Zippa Sparkwhisker
units.body: small, sleek and agile, long sinuous tail, slender limbs, tiny rounded ears
units.personality: Talkative, reckless, fiercely loyal, hates standing still.
units.quote: Delivery! Signed, sealed, shocked!
units.origin: Fastest courier between the foothill hamlets before the Heart called her.
units.weaponDesc: Two short copper rods with insulated rubber grips and sparking tips, linked by a thin chain.
units.passive: Static Build: each action adds a spark stack, increasing next hit. Visual: crackling hair.
units.ability1: Spark Jab: fast Lightning stab. Visual: yellow flash.
units.ability2: Chain Zip: hits two enemies. Visual: arcs jumping between them.
units.ability3: Short Circuit: lowers an enemy's speed. Visual: blue static coils.
units.ultimate: Thunderline Express: dashes through every enemy in a zigzag lightning trail. Visual: a long glowing bolt path with message scrolls fluttering.

units.name: Sister Calla Dawnmend
units.body: soft, sturdy and warm, generous curves, strong forearms from tending patients
units.personality: Patient, practical, hums while she works, firm bedside manner.
units.quote: Drink. Rest. Then we talk about being brave.
units.origin: Chapel lamp-keeper who tended wounded travelers on the forest road.
units.weaponDesc: A wooden staff topped with a small brass lantern holding a steady warm flame that never burns.
units.passive: Warm Glow: heals the lowest-HP ally slightly at turn start. Visual: soft golden motes.
units.ability1: Mend: heals one ally. Visual: lamp light pours over a wound.
units.ability2: Bless: removes one weak debuff. Visual: golden ring.
units.ability3: Lantern Flash: blinds enemies for a turn. Visual: a sudden bright flare.
units.ultimate: Dawn Embrace: a warm light heals everyone and raises shield. Visual: a sunrise bursts behind her.

units.name: Mordecai Gloam
units.body: tall, gaunt and lanky, stooped shoulders, long fingers
units.personality: Dry, gentle, morbid humor, kind to children, speaks softly.
units.quote: Everyone gets a quiet place. Let me show you yours.
units.origin: Village gravedigger who learned the dead keep secrets worth hearing.
units.weaponDesc: A long iron-headed shovel with black ribbon tied at the haft and small bone charms.
units.passive: Hollow Presence: enemies he afflicts have slightly lowered accuracy. Visual: a faint shadow haze.
units.ability1: Hex Mark: marks an enemy, increasing damage it takes. Visual: dark sigil.
units.ability2: Grave Chill: slows two enemies. Visual: frost-like shadows from the ground.
units.ability3: Spade Swing: heavy Dark hit. Visual: wide arc with black ribbon.
units.ultimate: Quiet Earth: a ring of shadow hands pins all enemies. Visual: dozens of dark hands rising from graves.

units.name: Ulric Cairnbreaker
units.body: short, very broad and densely muscled, thick limbs, big belly, powerful hands
units.personality: Gruff, patient, fond of stories, secretly sentimental.
units.quote: Lean on me, lad. I've been leaned on by mountains.
units.origin: Retired mine foreman called back to hold the line for the tower.
units.weaponDesc: A sturdy two-handed pickaxe with an iron head and a half-moon rock-plate shield strapped to the left arm.
units.passive: Rock Steady: cannot be pushed or knocked back. Visual: small stone spikes anchor his boots.
units.ability1: Granite Guard: gain a large shield. Visual: stone plates slide up.
units.ability2: Pick Breaker: heavy hit that lowers enemy defense. Visual: cracking ground.
units.ability3: Tremor Stomp: staggers the enemy line. Visual: shockwave in the dust.
units.ultimate: Mountainheart: becomes nearly immune for two turns and taunts all enemies. Visual: a stone shell forms around him.

units.name: Ashlyn Cinderbraid
units.body: athletic and toned, long legs, defined shoulders, curved horns
units.personality: Proud, flirtatious, competitive, fiercely protective of apprentices.
units.quote: Try to keep up. I do burn bright.
units.origin: Duelist-for-hire who paid off a forge debt and stayed to guard it.
units.weaponDesc: A slender rapier with a glowing ember-orange blade edge, a swept-hilt guard shaped like flame, and a red ribbon tied at the pommel.
units.passive: Kindling: each Fire hit raises the next Fire hit by 10%. Visual: embers trailing the blade.
units.ability1: Ember Lunge: fast thrust. Visual: flare along the line of the blade.
units.ability2: Spark Parry: counter the next attack. Visual: sparks at the guard.
units.ability3: Brand: burn enemy for damage over time. Visual: glowing sigil on the foe.
units.ultimate: Phoenix Flourish: five rapid thrusts ending in a rising flame arc. Visual: wings of fire behind her.

units.name: Juniper Gale
units.body: tiny delicate frame, long limbs relative to body, translucent leaf-veined ear-fins
units.personality: Playful, sharp-tongued, bores easily, deeply attentive when it counts.
units.quote: Listen. The wind is gossiping about you.
units.origin: Forest sprite who guarded a wind-shrine until the tower's crystal began to hum.
units.weaponDesc: A pair of small hanging bell-chimes on a hooked staff that ring with the wind and draw faint glowing spirals.
units.passive: Updraft: allies in her row have a small evasion boost. Visual: leaves drift upward.
units.ability1: Chime Shield: shields an ally. Visual: swirling bell ring.
units.ability2: Crosswind: pushes enemies out of position. Visual: sweeping gust lines.
units.ability3: Mist Lure: confuses one enemy. Visual: glowing spiral fog.
units.ultimate: Hurricane Hymn: all enemies are blown to the back and slowed. Visual: a large spiral of leaves and notes.

units.name: Tarn Deepcurrent
units.body: huge, thick-tailed and broad-shouldered, heavy plated back, powerful legs
units.personality: Patient, deliberate, deeply loyal, enjoys fishing and silence.
units.quote: Let them come. The river has all day.
units.origin: River-guardian of a ford who accepted the tower's call to protect travelers.
units.weaponDesc: A long-handled maul with a smooth river stone head bound in bronze wire and etched current patterns.
units.passive: Deep Calm: gains a shield each time an ally is hit. Visual: a gentle blue ripple.
units.ability1: Tide Wall: large shield for him. Visual: water sheet rises.
units.ability2: Undertow: pulls enemies to the front and lowers their speed. Visual: a swirl at their feet.
units.ability3: Maul Crash: heavy Water hit. Visual: splash ring.
units.ultimate: Flood Bulwark: a wave surrounds the party, giving shield and healing over time. Visual: a rising wall of crystalline water.

units.name: Brother Isidore Lumen
units.body: gaunt, tall-ish and wiry, long neck, prominent collarbones, calloused hands
units.personality: Soft-spoken, dryly funny, obsessed with tea and small kindnesses.
units.quote: Breathe. Then strike where the light falls.
units.origin: Monk who left a mountain cloister to teach battlefield calm.
units.weaponDesc: A long chain of wooden prayer beads with a small brass sun medallion at the end, used as a whip and focus.
units.passive: Inner Calm: gains energy when an ally is healed. Visual: faint sunbursts.
units.ability1: Radiant Strike: Light hit with the chain. Visual: golden whip arc.
units.ability2: Ward of Beads: shield one ally. Visual: floating beads circle.
units.ability3: Clarity: cleanses a debuff. Visual: soft sunlight.
units.ultimate: Hundred Lights: scatters beads that heal the party and strike enemies. Visual: a rain of glowing bead-lights.

units.name: Nyx Veilwhisper
units.body: slight and flexible, narrow shoulders, long slender legs, pointed ears
units.personality: Quiet, wry, loyal to a handful of people, hates crowds.
units.quote: You never saw me. That was the plan.
units.origin: Dusk-elf scout banished for refusing to burn a village, hired by the Guild.
units.weaponDesc: Two curved black-steel daggers with violet edge-glints and ribbon-wrapped grips; their shadows move a moment late.
units.passive: Slip Into Shade: first attack each turn ignores a taunt. Visual: her silhouette blurs.
units.ability1: Shadow Step: teleport behind an enemy and strike. Visual: violet mist.
units.ability2: Silent Cut: bonus damage to debuffed enemies. Visual: thin slash lines.
units.ability3: Smoke Veil: evade next attack. Visual: black smoke coil.
units.ultimate: Eclipse Dance: a series of unseen cuts through all enemies. Visual: darkness sweeps the stage, only knife glints show.

units.name: Captain Rhea Stormhail
units.body: tall, strongly built with broad shoulders and an upright stance
units.personality: Commanding, warm, speeches with dry humor, never abandons the wounded.
units.quote: On your feet. The storm's with us.
units.origin: Mercenary captain who lost her company and found a new one at the Gate.
units.weaponDesc: A long banner-spear with a storm-blue pennant crackling with static and a silver lightning bolt tip.
units.passive: Rally: allies gain energy at turn start if the banner is planted. Visual: pennant sparks.
units.ability1: Plant Standard: grants all allies a small attack bonus. Visual: banner slams into ground.
units.ability2: Crack Orders: grants an ally an extra action. Visual: a lightning snap.
units.ability3: Spear Jolt: Lightning hit that jumps to a second enemy. Visual: arc along the spear.
units.ultimate: Storm Charge: the whole party gets speed and attack boosts. Visual: banner raised, lightning striking behind.

units.name: Torvald Greywall
units.body: mountainous and broad with massive arms and a thick neck
units.personality: Slow to speak, gentle with small creatures, immovable on principle.
units.quote: I do not move. You do.
units.origin: Mountain-herd guardian who descended after the Heart's call echoed through the stone.
units.weaponDesc: A huge stone-headed maul wrapped with iron bands and carved with climbing vines.
units.passive: Immovable: reduces damage from the first hit each turn. Visual: stone plates glinting.
units.ability1: Cliff Stance: massive shield and taunt. Visual: stone rises around him.
units.ability2: Boulder Throw: ranged Earth damage. Visual: a thrown rock.
units.ability3: Quake Step: stuns the front enemy. Visual: crack through the ground.
units.ultimate: Avalanche Guard: shields all allies and counters the next attack. Visual: falling boulders form a wall.

units.name: Marisol Pyreheart
units.body: hourglass figure, strong thighs, small waist, curvy proportions
units.personality: Brilliant, sarcastic, careless about safety, generous with friends.
units.quote: Don't touch that. Okay, touch that one.
units.origin: Alchemist whose lab burned down three times; the Frosted Mug gave her a fourth.
units.weaponDesc: A leather bandolier of corked vials glowing with orange, green and violet fumes, plus a long brass tongs.
units.passive: Volatile Mix: debuffs from her potions last one turn longer. Visual: swirling smoke.
units.ability1: Flash Flask: blinds and burns. Visual: orange burst.
units.ability2: Sticky Resin: slows enemies. Visual: glowing tar.
units.ability3: Quick Brew: gives an ally energy. Visual: bubbling vial.
units.ultimate: Grand Combustion: a massive controlled explosion with lingering fire. Visual: a plume with colored smoke rings.

units.name: Kestrel
units.body: compact, wiry and athletic, powerful shoulders, short legs, quick stance
units.personality: Direct, brave, impatient, respects a Summoner who commits to a choice.
units.quote: Pick a road. I'll burn it clear.
units.origin: The first card drawn in Silverbrook, bound to the Summoner's hand.
units.weaponDesc: Two short swords with matching ember-glow edges, black steel and red cord grips, a hairline of blue-silver Celestium inlay near the guard.
units.passive: First Draw: opening-turn attacks deal bonus damage. Visual: blades flare red.
units.ability1: Ember Cross: crossing slashes. Visual: X-shaped flame.
units.ability2: Heat Surge: gain energy when she takes damage. Visual: flaring aura.
units.ability3: Blade Rush: charge through the front line. Visual: horizontal fire streak.
units.ultimate: Fallen Gate: a huge downward double slash that detonates on impact. Visual: a gate of flame crashing down.

units.name: Sable
units.body: tall, lean and elegant, long limbs, narrow waist
units.personality: Observant, dryly funny, protective, prefers information over heroics.
units.quote: Not a haven yet. A claim.
units.origin: Second card drawn in Silverbrook; scouts the road before anyone walks it.
units.weaponDesc: A recurve bow of pale ash wood with a silver wind-sigil carved into the riser and a green cloth strip tied to the limb.
units.passive: Borrowed Breath: restores a little energy to an ally each turn. Visual: green wind swirl.
units.ability1: Gale Mark: makes the next attack on a target more certain. Visual: green sigil on the foe.
units.ability2: Wind Arrow: ranged Wind hit. Visual: a spiral arrow trail.
units.ability3: Cut the Chain: removes an enemy control effect. Visual: a shot severing a chain.
units.ultimate: Hundred Winds: a volley of arrows that carry energy to all allies. Visual: a rain of green-glowing arrows.

units.name: Thalassa Brinegate
units.body: statuesque and broad-shouldered, long legs, strong arms, gill-like markings along the ribs
units.personality: Regal, patient, fiercely protective, secretly homesick.
units.quote: The tide does not ask permission.
units.origin: Sentinel of a sunken gate who followed the Heart's song inland.
units.weaponDesc: A tall trident with a coral-crown tip and a large round pearl-inlaid shield with engraved waves.
units.passive: Tidal Guard: damage taken partially restored as shield. Visual: water motes ring the shield.
units.ability1: Bulwark Wave: shield for all allies. Visual: wave across the party.
units.ability2: Trident Thrust: Water hit that lowers enemy attack. Visual: bubbles trail the point.
units.ability3: Pearl Barrier: reflects the next attack. Visual: shield turns mirror-bright.
units.ultimate: Tidal Gate: a colossal wave gate protects the party and crashes on enemies. Visual: a giant arch of water opens behind her.

units.name: Corvin Ashmantle
units.body: gaunt and tall with long limbs, hunched shoulders, feathered forearms
units.personality: Sardonic, scholarly, collector of odd facts, hates being rushed.
units.quote: Every omen has a price. This one's yours.
units.origin: Hex-scholar who read an omen in the Heart's glow and followed it.
units.weaponDesc: A tall black staff topped with a small raven skull wrapped in violet cords and hanging charms.
units.passive: Omen: lowers one enemy's defense when he applies a debuff. Visual: black feathers drifting.
units.ability1: Murder Mark: marks an enemy and weakens it. Visual: crow silhouettes circle.
units.ability2: Hex Cry: reduces enemy attack. Visual: a harsh caw soundwave.
units.ability3: Shadow Wings: evade and reposition. Visual: wings of shadow.
units.ultimate: Murder of Crows: a flock devours enemy buffs and strikes all. Visual: swarm of black birds sweeping the field.

units.name: Tsukiko Raikami
units.body: small and graceful, narrow waist, three fluffy tails, light stance
units.personality: Teasing, vain, strategic, loves gambling and sweets.
units.quote: Roll the dice. Thunder loves a gambler.
units.origin: Shrine fox who bet her tails and won a market stall in the bargain.
units.weaponDesc: A pair of folding steel war-fans painted with thunder clouds, edges sparking with lightning.
units.passive: Static Fox-Fire: every third attack adds a chain lightning hit. Visual: floating blue fox-fires.
units.ability1: Fan Flash: fast two-hit strike. Visual: crackling arcs.
units.ability2: Thunder Step: dodge and counter. Visual: afterimage with lightning.
units.ability3: Kitsune Veil: grants allies a speed boost. Visual: fox-fire swirls.
units.ultimate: Thunder Shrine Descent: a roaring lightning pillar and gates of thunder strike all enemies. Visual: a torii of lightning crashing down.

units.name: Seraphine Auric
units.body: tall, willowy and regal, long neck, elegant limbs, detachable ribbon-like light wings
units.personality: Gentle, composed, teases, secretly lonely.
units.quote: Sing with me. The light carries.
units.origin: Cantor who fell from a cloud-chapel and found warmth at the Mug.
units.weaponDesc: A golden harp-topped staff with strings that glow when plucked, ribbon streamers trailing.
units.passive: Hymn Aura: allies gain regen while she sings. Visual: floating musical notes.
units.ability1: Cantor's Chord: heals the party slightly. Visual: ripples of light.
units.ability2: Gilded Ward: shield on one ally. Visual: golden ring.
units.ability3: Sunburst Note: Light damage and blind. Visual: a bright flash.
units.ultimate: Dawnchoir: full heal plus attack boost for the party. Visual: a huge golden choir sunrise.

units.name: Ignatius Vael-Drakon
units.body: broad, horned and heavily muscled, thick tail, plated chest
units.personality: Gruff, wise, deeply loyal, cooks well.
units.quote: Behind the wall, little ones.
units.origin: Last guard of a fallen dragon-keep who swore his shield to the Heart.
units.weaponDesc: A huge tower shield forged from dragon scale, carved with a roaring dragon and glowing embers; a short war axe is strapped on the back.
units.passive: Dragon Hide: reduces Fire damage and reflects a small amount. Visual: ember glints on scales.
units.ability1: Scale Wall: huge shield. Visual: scales shimmer.
units.ability2: Cinder Roar: taunt and burn. Visual: small fire breath.
units.ability3: Axe Cleave: heavy hit. Visual: red arc.
units.ultimate: Dragon's Embrace: a fire barrier protects the party and scorches attackers. Visual: wings of flame unfurl.

units.name: Maelor Deepvein
units.body: gigantic, craggy and thick, arms like pillars, slow and deliberate
units.personality: Wise, slow to speak, collects flowers, a patient storyteller.
units.quote: Mountains remember. Let me remind them of you.
units.origin: Giant who slept in the quarry for centuries until the Heart's hum woke him.
units.weaponDesc: A massive staff of dark stone with carved runes and a heart-shaped amber crystal at the top.
units.passive: Ground Truth: terrain effects he places last longer. Visual: glowing amber runes beneath him.
units.ability1: Stone Lock: roots an enemy. Visual: rocks encase feet.
units.ability2: Tremor Field: slows all enemies. Visual: cracked ground.
units.ability3: Pillar Strike: heavy Earth hit. Visual: a stone pillar.
units.ultimate: Tectonic Verdict: the ground rises to crush and pin all enemies. Visual: giant rock walls close in.

units.name: Nerissa Pearlwhisper
units.body: graceful and full-figured, long legs, soft curves, delicate finned ears and wrists
units.personality: Soothing, flirtatious, poised, secretly mischievous.
units.quote: Let the tide carry you. I'll hum.
units.origin: Singer from a drowned city who found a new stage at the Argent Market.
units.weaponDesc: A harp carved from a giant pearl-lined conch shell with silver strings that shimmer like moonlit water.
units.passive: Tide Song: heals the party a little whenever she plays a skill. Visual: drifting bubbles.
units.ability1: Pearl Chord: heals one ally and cleanses. Visual: pearl ripple.
units.ability2: Undertow Note: pulls an enemy forward. Visual: swirling water.
units.ability3: Moonwash: shields the party. Visual: silver wave.
units.ultimate: Moon-Tide Requiem: a huge tide rises, healing allies and soaking enemies into slowness. Visual: a full moon over a crashing wave.

units.name: Vesper Nightingale
units.body: small, agile and delicately built, long legs, slim waist
units.personality: Cool, sly, theatrical, disarmingly kind to street cats.
units.quote: The finale is mine. Applause optional.
units.origin: Shadow fae who sang assassins to sleep before turning her blades on the court.
units.weaponDesc: Two slender silver stilettos with violet glows along the edges and a ribbon of shadow wrapped at the hilt.
units.passive: Silent Aria: attacks from behind deal bonus damage and do not break stealth. Visual: shadow notes.
units.ability1: Needle Aria: rapid two-hit strike. Visual: violet streaks.
units.ability2: Curtain Fall: negates the next attack. Visual: a shadow curtain drops.
units.ability3: Encore: repeats her last attack at reduced power. Visual: afterimage.
units.ultimate: Nocturne of Needles: a flurry through all enemies, finishing with a silent burst. Visual: scattered notes and a black moon.

units.name: Aeolus Brandt
units.body: tall and powerfully built, broad chest, large hands, weathered
units.personality: Steady, proud, protective, a quiet wit.
units.quote: No storm gets past this gate.
units.origin: Warden of a windswept mountain pass who sealed it for ten winters alone.
units.weaponDesc: A giant tower shield of dull steel etched with wind spirals and white feather fringe; inside it hides a short-handled hammer.
units.passive: Wall of Wind: reduces projectile damage for the party. Visual: ripples of air around the shield.
units.ability1: Gale Guard: gain a large shield and taunt. Visual: spiral of wind around him.
units.ability2: Shield Gust: knock back and slow enemies. Visual: white gust cone.
units.ability3: Updraft Slam: lifts an enemy and stuns. Visual: a spiraling uppercut.
units.ultimate: Pass of a Thousand Winds: a hurricane wall protects the party and shreds enemies at its edges. Visual: a spinning wind wall with silver streaks.

units.name: TESSERAX-9 (Tess)
units.body: compact, stocky humanoid frame of brass and silver plates with oversized hands, exposed coils at the joints, a glowing core in the chest
units.personality: Curious, polite, collects odd facts, slightly bewildered by humor.
units.quote: Query: why is the party laughing? Updating.
units.origin: Automaton built to power a Celestium relay, awakened by the Heart's frequency.
units.weaponDesc: A long brass staff topped with a spinning tesla coil that crackles with blue-white arcs.
units.passive: Overclock: gains extra energy when an ally uses a Lightning skill. Visual: crackling blue sparks.
units.ability1: Arc Lock: stuns one enemy. Visual: web of lightning.
units.ability2: Capacitor: stores energy to boost the next skill. Visual: glowing coil.
units.ability3: Chain Surge: hits multiple enemies. Visual: jumping arcs.
units.ultimate: Grand Dynamo Cascade: a massive field of chain lightning that stuns all enemies. Visual: a glowing coil tower and a sky of arcs.

units.name: Lumina 'Lumi' Starlit
units.body: tiny, delicately built with long limbs, small star-shaped markings on shoulders
units.personality: Giddy, kind, endlessly curious, easily distracted by shiny things.
units.quote: Look up! They're waving at us!
units.origin: Star-fae who traded her night-watch for the Heart's warm light.
units.weaponDesc: A floating loom-like ring of silver with strings of stars that she plucks and weaves into patterns.
units.passive: Starlight Thread: allies she buffs gain a small shield. Visual: tiny glowing threads.
units.ability1: Weave Light: heals an ally and grants a regen. Visual: star threads stitch a wound.
units.ability2: Star Seal: buffs the party's defense. Visual: constellation circle.
units.ability3: Comet Stitch: Light damage to an enemy. Visual: shooting star.
units.ultimate: Grand Constellation: a giant starry web heals, shields and boosts all allies. Visual: a full-sky constellation unfolding.

units.name: Orsolya Granitecrown
units.body: powerfully built, broad shoulders and strong thighs, hourglass torso, strong arms
units.personality: Commanding, shrewd, gracious to underlings, loves gemstones.
units.quote: Kneel? No. But do be impressed.
units.origin: Half-giant ruler of a mountain hold who journeyed to see the Heart.
units.weaponDesc: A tall scepter of black granite with silver bands and a cluster of violet crystal at the top.
units.passive: Crown of Stone: terrain effects also shield allies. Visual: crystals chime.
units.ability1: Crystal Lock: roots and damages an enemy. Visual: crystals burst from the ground.
units.ability2: Gem Barrier: shield on the party. Visual: floating gems.
units.ability3: Sovereign Edict: lowers enemy defense. Visual: golden stone runes.
units.ultimate: Throne of the Mountain: raises a crystal throne that buffs allies and traps enemies. Visual: giant granite throne with glowing amethysts.

units.name: Draven Emberlord
units.body: large, powerfully muscled, broad chest and long horns, thick tail
units.personality: Charming, theatrical, ruthless in battle, fair with allies.
units.quote: Hell is a gentleman's hobby.
units.origin: Demon marshal who cast off his legion to fight for something warmer.
units.weaponDesc: A huge obsidian greatsword with a molten crack running down the blade, silver-violet guard, and a fire-wrapped hilt.
units.passive: Infernal Might: each kill grants a stacking attack boost. Visual: flame crown.
units.ability1: Hellfire Cleave: a wide Fire arc. Visual: crescent flame.
units.ability2: Molten Guard: a counter stance that burns attackers. Visual: lava cracks.
units.ability3: Marshal's Charge: dash and strike. Visual: trail of embers.
units.ultimate: Infernal Dominion: a huge demonic gate erupts, striking all enemies with fire. Visual: a hellgate with black flames.

units.name: Thetis Maelstrom
units.body: tall, broad and powerfully built, thick limbs, finned forearms
units.personality: Calm, protective, mischievous sense of humor, loves storms.
units.quote: Let the sea decide who passes.
units.origin: Titan guard of the abyssal gate who emerged when the Heart sang through the deep.
units.weaponDesc: A giant scallop-shell tower shield rimmed with silver, inner glow of violet-blue crystals; a spiral-shaped spear sits on the back.
units.passive: Pressure: reflects a portion of damage taken. Visual: whirlpool halo.
units.ability1: Whirlpool Wall: massive party shield. Visual: spinning water.
units.ability2: Pressure Slam: heavy Water hit that lowers enemy defense. Visual: crushing water burst.
units.ability3: Undertow Spear: pulls and damages. Visual: a swirling trail.
units.ultimate: Maelstrom Aegis: a giant whirlpool protects the party and crushes enemies. Visual: a colossal spiral of water and pearls.

units.name: Elder Tuan Windshell
units.body: small, round and ancient, a large domed shell with swirling wind carvings, short sturdy limbs
units.personality: Slow, wise, teasing, nap-prone, speaks in riddles and tea metaphors.
units.quote: Hurry less. The wind arrives anyway.
units.origin: Wind-spirit tortoise who sheltered the first travelers of Silverwood and answered the Heart.
units.weaponDesc: A gnarled wooden staff with a floating contained Celestium crystal that spins with a spiral of wind.
units.passive: Ancient Shell: reduces all damage by a flat amount, increased by allies in front. Visual: wind carvings glowing.
units.ability1: Shell Guard: giant shield for the party. Visual: shell lights up.
units.ability2: Gale Lesson: cleanses debuffs and grants regen. Visual: gentle breeze.
units.ability3: Tortoise Thump: Wind counter-strike. Visual: shockwave ring.
units.ultimate: Eternal Gale Sanctuary: a spherical wind barrier protects the party for three turns. Visual: a giant glowing shell dome of spiraling wind.

units.name: Solenne Auralis
units.body: tall and regal, graceful, defined shoulders, elegant long limbs
units.personality: Compassionate, composed, subtly teasing, a firm will.
units.quote: Rise. The dawn has been waiting for you.
units.origin: High priestess who first felt the Heart wake and walked a thousand miles to meet it.
units.weaponDesc: A tall golden scepter topped with a contained Celestium crystal that radiates dawn-colored light; ribbons trail from it.
units.passive: Dawn's Blessing: full-HP allies gain a shield each turn. Visual: golden motes.
units.ability1: Radiant Grace: large heal on one ally. Visual: a column of light.
units.ability2: Crystal Ward: shields the party. Visual: orbiting crystals.
units.ability3: Sunbreak: Light damage with a stun. Visual: a flare.
units.ultimate: Celestial Dawn: full heal, revives a fallen ally, grants huge attack. Visual: a massive sunrise with falling feathers of light.

units.name: Erebus Nightcrown
units.body: towering, tall and lean with long limbs, wisps of void-smoke trailing
units.personality: Elegant, calm, secretly lonely, shows kindness in odd ways.
units.quote: Kneel only if you wish. The void will wait.
units.origin: Prince of the void who rejected his throne after hearing the Heart's warm hum.
units.weaponDesc: A tall black scepter with a floating void-crystal at the top, wrapped by violet ribbons and slow orbiting stars.
units.passive: Regent's Domain: enemies' buffs last one turn less. Visual: a ring of void sigils on the floor.
units.ability1: Void Chain: roots and weakens one enemy. Visual: black chains with violet sparks.
units.ability2: Royal Decree: lowers attack of all enemies. Visual: dark sigil in the sky.
units.ability3: Starfall Shard: Dark hit that ignores some defense. Visual: black shooting star.
units.ultimate: Throne of the Abyss: opens a void gate that pulls enemies in, stuns and deals massive damage. Visual: a colossal black crown above a swirling void.

units.name: Ragnhild Thunderveil
units.body: tall, athletic and powerfully built, defined arms and legs, broad shoulders
units.personality: Bold, loud, protective, loves a good feast.
units.quote: Let the storm sing our names!
units.origin: Valkyrie who followed a storm to the Heart and swore her spear to the Summoner.
units.weaponDesc: A long silver spear with a lightning-forked tip, a contained Celestium crystal in the shaft, and wing-shaped crossguard.
units.passive: Stormborne: every action adds charge; at 5 charge, the next attack is a lightning strike. Visual: crackling aura.
units.ability1: Thunder Thrust: piercing Lightning hit. Visual: forked bolt along the spear.
units.ability2: Valkyrie's Leap: jump strike hitting two enemies. Visual: arcing silhouette.
units.ability3: Storm Veil: evasion and counter. Visual: cloak of lightning.
units.ultimate: Ragnarok Descent: she rides a lightning bolt down onto the enemy line, exploding in a massive storm. Visual: a gigantic Valkyrie silhouette and bolts splitting the sky.

units.name: Tobias Rake
units.body: lanky, sunburnt and slightly stooped, big feet, long arms
units.personality: Earnest, clumsy, talks to the crops.
units.quote: They grow better if you sing.
units.origin: Orphan farmhand who followed the glow to the tower.
units.perk: Green Thumb: Farmstead cycles finish slightly faster.
units.toolDesc: A wooden dibber stick and a dented tin watering can painted with a smiling sun.

units.name: Mina Dewlight
units.body: short, sturdy and round-faced, strong shoulders from carrying water
units.personality: Cheerful, strong for her size, always humming.
units.quote: Careful, it's full!
units.origin: Village well-girl who walked a day to join the tower.
units.perk: Steady Draw: Stone Well yields a little extra Water.
units.toolDesc: A shaped wooden yoke with two oak buckets, one painted with a water drop.

units.name: Gorm Hatchet
units.body: huge, broad and muscular with a soft round belly
units.personality: Soft-spoken, loves carving, cries at sad songs.
units.quote: Timber... sorry, tree.
units.origin: Orc logger who put down his axe against people, kept it for trees.
units.perk: Timberman: Lumber Mill produces extra Firewood.
units.toolDesc: A broad double-bit felling axe with a long ash handle wrapped in red cloth.

units.name: Wren Kettle
units.body: average height, comfortably curvy, strong forearms
units.personality: Bustling, motherly, scolds you into eating.
units.quote: Sit. Eat. Talk after.
units.origin: Inn cook who lost her inn to a storm.
units.perk: Hearty Meals: Kitchen output is slightly boosted.
units.toolDesc: A big dented copper stockpot with a wooden ladle hanging from a hook on the rim.

units.name: Hobb Ledgerfoot
units.body: short, round-bellied, nimble fingers
units.personality: Polite, shrewd, cannot resist a bargain.
units.quote: A fair price is a friendly price.
units.origin: Traveling trader who found a permanent stall.
units.perk: Fair Haggle: Argent Market earns a little extra Gold.
units.toolDesc: A polished brass abacus with colored beads and a leather strap.

units.name: Sera Quickneedle
units.body: slim and graceful with long limbs
units.personality: Calm, precise, hums lullabies.
units.quote: Hold still. I've almost got the hem.
units.origin: Elven tailor who left a cold court for warm company.
units.perk: Soft Stitch: Hearth Nursery children recover and grow slightly faster.
units.toolDesc: A slim carved wooden case holding silver needles and bright spools of thread.

units.name: Dunstan Pickaxe
units.body: short, broad and muscular, thick forearms
units.personality: Gruff, hard-working, hums mining songs.
units.quote: Nothing breaks like honest rock.
units.origin: Dwarf miner who prefers daylight work.
units.perk: Fine Chisel: Stone Quarry output is slightly higher.
units.toolDesc: A worn iron pick with a wooden handle and a chisel tucked into the belt.

units.name: Lio Marigold
units.body: tall, lean with long legs and large feet
units.personality: Gentle, nervous, full of flower trivia.
units.quote: They'll bloom, I promise.
units.origin: Hare-folk gardener who fled a burned orchard.
units.perk: Quick Sprouts: Farmstead cycles finish slightly faster.
units.toolDesc: A small iron trowel and a satchel stitched with marigold flowers.

units.name: Ilsa Brewbright
units.body: curvy and strong with broad shoulders
units.personality: Boisterous, motherly, never forgets a name.
units.quote: First round's on the house. Don't tell the boss.
units.origin: Innkeeper who inherited the Mug and kept it lively.
units.perk: Good Cheer: Frosted Mug boosts satisfaction slightly.
units.toolDesc: Three stacked frosty pewter tankards with a hammered brass tray.

units.name: Fenwick Quill
units.body: small and slight with ink-stained fingers
units.personality: Fussy, absent-minded, delighted by footnotes.
units.quote: Citation needed. Oh, I'll cite myself.
units.origin: Gnome archivist whose library burned.
units.perk: Careful Notes: Deck Hall training grants a little extra XP.
units.toolDesc: A long feather quill and a thick leather-bound ledger with brass corners.

units.name: Nessa Tidewell
units.body: tall, graceful and slender with webbed fingers
units.personality: Gentle, quiet, hums to the sick.
units.quote: Drink. The lake remembers you.
units.origin: Lake healer drawn by the Heart's hum.
units.perk: Soothing Waters: Frosted Mug produces extra Tonics.
units.toolDesc: A wide shell bowl with a wooden pestle and tiny glass vials.

units.name: Brakka Ironsmoke
units.body: tall, broad and strongly muscled
units.personality: Blunt, motherly, roars with laughter.
units.quote: Quench it. Don't cry over it.
units.origin: Smith who earned her anvil in a mercenary camp.
units.perk: Hammer Rhythm: Forge training grants a bit more XP.
units.toolDesc: A heavy forge hammer with a worn grip and long iron tongs.

units.name: Odalys Thornfield
units.body: slender and medium height, bark patterns along arms and legs
units.personality: Calm, wise, sleeps in sunbeams.
units.quote: Patience grows everything.
units.origin: Dryad of a fallen orchard that found a new soil.
units.perk: Orchard's Gift: Farmstead yields extra Food.
units.toolDesc: Silver shears with a vine-wrapped handle and a pouch of glowing seeds.

units.name: Cato Lanternjaw
units.body: short, wiry and quick, big feet
units.personality: Chatty, cautious, great with maps.
units.quote: Trust me. I've been lost here before.
units.origin: Halfling scout who mapped every ditch in Silverwood.
units.perk: Far Sight: Guild expeditions reveal extra info.
units.toolDesc: A brass spyglass and a small hooded lantern, both dented but well-polished.

units.name: Yarrow Moss
units.body: very tall, bark-skinned, thick limbs and a soft rounded frame
units.personality: Very patient, quiet, slow to anger.
units.quote: Sleep. The forest will keep watch.
units.origin: A sapling-giant who grew beside the tower.
units.perk: Gentle Giant: Hearth Nursery capacity and care speed increase.
units.toolDesc: A small branch with a bell and ribbon, humming softly.

units.name: Pell Fortunecoin
units.body: small, slim and quick with a long bushy tail
units.personality: Charming, slippery, honest about being dishonest.
units.quote: Odds? Never heard of them.
units.origin: Fox gambler who lost everything and won it back.
units.perk: Windfall: Argent Market sometimes yields bonus Gold.
units.toolDesc: A pair of ivory dice and a gold coin hanging on a ribbon.

units.name: Dr. Ambrose Pennywhistle
units.body: average height, slight stoop, thin
units.personality: Absent-minded, enthusiastic, gets lost mid-sentence.
units.quote: Fascinating! Wait, where was I?
units.origin: Professor who followed a rare moth into the forest.
units.perk: Research Notes: Deck Hall training grants extra XP.
units.toolDesc: A brass-latched specimen case and a magnifying glass on a chain.

units.name: Kasimir Veil
units.body: tall, slender with sharp shoulders and a long tail
units.personality: Suave, calculating, secretly generous.
units.quote: Everything has a price. Let's find yours.
units.origin: Broker who retired from a gilded city.
units.perk: Silver Tongue: Argent Market earns extra Gold and lowers prices.
units.toolDesc: A gold-edged ledger and a tiny brass scale with violet weights.

units.name: Mother Hesper
units.body: slender, elderly yet upright, delicate hands
units.personality: Gentle, wise, mild humor.
units.quote: Sleep now, little spark.
units.origin: Elder who sang the tower's first lullaby.
units.perk: Moonlit Lullaby: Hearth Nursery births are safer and satisfaction rises.
units.toolDesc: A carved wooden rocking chair with a woven blanket that glows softly.

units.name: Ruvik Glasseye
units.body: small and wiry, large ears
units.personality: Eccentric, fast-talking, proud of his craft.
units.quote: See? Everything's clearer with the right glass.
units.origin: Goblin optician who built the Guild's spyglass.
units.perk: Sharp Lens: Guild expeditions have greater success chance.
units.toolDesc: A leather case of ground lenses, tiny files and a brass loupe.

units.name: Tamsin Starling
units.body: tiny with delicate limbs and clover-leaf ears
units.personality: Bubbly, mischievous, easily bored.
units.quote: Pick a clover. Any clover!
units.origin: Cloverkin who hid under a barn and brought luck.
units.perk: Lucky Clover: Barn livestock produce bonus goods and storage rolls improve.
units.toolDesc: A tiny satchel stitched with four-leaf clovers, full of lucky charms.

units.name: Magister Oru
units.body: tall, slim, polished white and gold frame with an exposed glowing core
units.personality: Polite, precise, curious about jokes.
units.quote: Processing... humor module unavailable.
units.origin: Automaton archive keeper reawakened by the Heart.
units.perk: Perfect Memory: Deck Hall research and training are faster.
units.toolDesc: A thin glowing slate tablet with etched constellations and a small floating core.

units.name: Sunniva Hearthsong
units.body: tall, strong and full-figured with warm presence
units.personality: Radiant, generous, a little proud of her recipes.
units.quote: Eat. Even the stars get hungry.
units.origin: Cook whose stew once saved a starving village.
units.perk: Starlight Feast: Kitchen output rises and boosts satisfaction.
units.toolDesc: A big pot with silver rim and a glowing Celestium core underneath.

units.name: Elder Ysolde Everwell
units.body: tall, ethereal and flowing with translucent water-limbs
units.personality: Calm, ancient, gentle, loves tea.
units.quote: Drink deeply. The well remembers.
units.origin: Ancient spirit of a spring beneath the tower.
units.perk: Everwell: Stone Well is never empty and gives all rooms a bit of Water bonus.
units.toolDesc: A silver chalice with a contained Celestium crystal and a never-empty spring of water.
